title: Daman Sakina Choro, Wo Guzar Gaya Zamana
body:
Bachpan Ka Wada Mainay, Sajday Mai Hay Nibhana
<<DIVIDER>>
Sabr-o-Raza Ka Daman Theray Haath Say Na Chuthay
Maray Thamachay Zalim, Chaey Goshwaray Lootay
Hur Haal Main Sakina Nana Ka Deen Bachana
<<DIVIDER>>
Tera Bhi Imthihaan Hai Mera Bhi Imthinhaan Hay
Mayree Karbala Hay Manzil, Zindan Thera Makan Hay
Tujh Ko Aseer Ho Ker Hay Kufa Shaam Jana
<<DIVIDER>>
Laynay Gaey Thay Panee Phir Lout Ker Na Aaey
Teray Baad Ashqia Nay, Khayam Hain Jalaey
Afsos Bhaiya Ghazi Parda Meyra Bachana
